rule: One record validates a consumer-retained completion declaration for one open position. Its artifact declaration version and all evidence instants are exact semver and known-offset RFC3339 with at most millisecond precision respectively. Red and green recorded controls have distinct cases in one run. A readable separately attributed outcome retains the linked position baseline exactly, names its evidence-source locator, is owned by neither the measured package, position, nor action authority, and moves from outside to inside the role setpoint. Its cadence names the linked review cadence. The causal sequence is before < invocation/red/green <= rollback <= after <= closeWindow.startedAt < satisfied recurrence <= closeWindow.endedAt; the close window has strictly increasing bounds. Reference and locator strings lexically reject explicit inline credential, provider-value, and central-adoption-decision payload assignments after ignoring Unicode default-ignorables; ordinary identifiers containing those words are permitted. The same comparison normalization prevents ignored characters from disguising a measured position or action authority. Runs outside the window are retained history; an in-window violation violates closure, an in-window indeterminate makes closure indeterminate absent a violation, and satisfaction needs at least one satisfied run after startedAt and no later than endedAt. Their contents, authorship, provider truth, and any adoption claim are not authenticated, and the lexical check cannot prove opaque pointers free of other sensitive material. Missing, unreadable, or temporally invalid evidence is indeterminate, never satisfied.
